messages.error: An error has occurred! The password could not be changed.

revocation.question: The old password may have been leaked or stolen
revocation.explanation: Changing your password alone does not lock someone else out, because passkeys, SSH keys and repository access tokens each keep working on their own. Select this only if someone may have seen your old password, then choose what to revoke.
revocation.passkeys: Delete all passkeys. You will have to register your devices again the next time you sign in with one.
revocation.sshKeys: Delete all SSH keys. Repository access over SSH stops working until you add a key again.
revocation.vcsAccessTokens: Delete all repository access tokens. Cloning over HTTPS with a token stops working until you create a new one.
